query:
SELECT t.id AS "id!: i64", t.name,
                      COUNT(f.id) AS "count!: i64"
               FROM file_tag t
               LEFT JOIN file_tag_rel r ON r.tag_id = t.id
               LEFT JOIN file f ON f.id = r.file_id
                    AND (?1 IS NULL OR f.is_private = 0 OR f.user_id = ?1)
               GROUP BY t.id, t.name
               ORDER BY t.name
